validation_status: DRY-RUN COMPLETE — 6 VERIFIED + 3 EXCLUDED. The first proposal of 6 repos was committed at 0fc1656; box 4 reproducibility-only check exposed 3 of those (sindresorhus/got, pallets/click, sinonjs/sinon) as below the locked ≥50 source-files minimum. Per operator decision (option B), they were marked EXCLUDED with reason `below_min_source_files` and 3 replacements were cloned + verified (Textualize/rich, prettier/prettier, pytest-dev/pytest). All 6 VERIFIED entries below carry measured values from the dry-run. Per-repo bug-fix PR labels and exact test-runtime under load are STILL pending box 4 candidate-pool generation (box 4b/c).
selection_criteria_summary: Public GitHub; permissive license (MIT / Apache-2.0 / BSD-3 / ISC); ≥30 bug-fix PRs in last 24 months; reproducible test command ≤5 min on warm cache; 50-2000 source files (excluding tests/vendor/node_modules); last commit ≤6 months old; primary language TypeScript / JavaScript / Python.
selection_principle: Span ≥2 of {TS, JS, Py} and ≥2 size buckets; favor fast deterministic local tests; avoid huge / slow / infra-heavy repos.
diversity_note: After amendment: 6 VERIFIED repos span JavaScript (3) + Python (3). TypeScript coverage is LOST relative to the first proposal because (a) sindresorhus/got was excluded for below-min size and (b) josdejong/mathjs's primary source language was correctly identified during dry-run as JavaScript (not TypeScript — JSDoc-typed) rather than TS as initially estimated. Pre-reg criterion 'span ≥2 of {TS, JS, Py}' is satisfied with JS + Py. Size buckets: 4 small + 2 medium (mathjs, prettier near the upper edge of medium). No 'large' bucket pick. If TS coverage matters for the publishable claim, this gap should be surfaced in the final report, not silently absorbed.
